scripts.sim:android: flutter emulators -d android_medium 2>/dev/null | grep android_medium || flutter emulators --launch Medium_Phone_API_34 --name android_medium; flutter emulators --launch android_medium
scripts.build:macos: pnpm set-env prod && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build macos --release; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.build:android: pnpm set-env prod && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build appbundle --release; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.build:android:apk: pnpm set-env prod && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build apk --release; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.build:ios: pnpm set-env prod && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build ios --release; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.release:ios: pnpm set-env prod && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && shorebird release ios; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.patch:macos: pnpm set-env prod && shorebird patch macos; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.patch:android: pnpm set-env prod && shorebird patch android; pnpm set-env dev
scripts.patch:ios: pnpm set-env prod && shorebird patch ios; pnpm set-env dev
